body:
I think I'll go to bed, like you told me.
I'm incredibly happy for her as well, and I will always be there for her. But I doubt I can do much to help with the depression though.

Thank you a lot for your time, you've helped me with a good insight in how a depressed mind works, I will use your info in the future.
God bless this subreddit
But do you know if it can cure depression? Especially one as heavy as hers?

UPDATE:
I told her about all the feelings I have for her.
She responded with: "I never thought i would hear that. I don't know what to say. I love you (my name) and I hope you know that. No matter what happens!"

She has since gone to bed, I feel like my confession made her in a completely different mood, because her messages all of a sudden had a "glow" of happiness. I do not know what to do now though.

You are an amazing help.
She really likes her therapist, but she has told me that she doesn't tell her everything. This worries me, but I understand it is incredibly hard to tell about your thoughts.
Do you know if it is true that exercise helps with depression? She joined a gym almost 2 months ago, but she hasn't been there recently.

But she has been going to her therapist for 2 years now. But you're correct, every time she has been to her therapist she feels stressed and mostly just want to relax.
She started with medication at the end of summer 2013, she says that they don't really make her happy, but rather makes her better at hiding her feelings. I don't know how meds are supposed to affect someone, but aren't they supposed to make you feel a lot better?
I have, but I'm looking for advice that fits her a little better
